title: Associate Project Manager
description:
**Project Manager – Technical Delivery** **About Seventh Triangle Consulting**
Seventh Triangle Consulting is a Shopify Premier Partner helping eCommerce and D2C brands build, scale, and optimize their digital businesses through technology, eCommerce, and growth solutions. **About the Role**
We are looking for an ownership\-driven Project Manager to manage the end\-to\-end delivery of eCommerce and software projects.
This is a hands\-on delivery role, not just coordination. You should be able to understand requirements, identify gaps and edge cases, document solutions, manage clients, and drive projects to successful delivery. **Key Responsibilities*** Gather and understand client requirements and translate them into clear functional requirements.
* Prepare SRS, BRD, user stories, and project documentation.
* Identify gaps, edge cases, validations, dependencies, and risks.
* Plan tasks, timelines, priorities, and project milestones.
* Coordinate with Developers, QA, and clients throughout the project.
* Manage client communication, expectations, feedback, and change requests.
* Track blockers and ensure timely resolution and delivery.
* Support UAT, releases, go\-live, and post\-live activities.
* Take complete ownership of project delivery from requirement to closure.

 **Must\-Have Skills*** Strong logical and analytical thinking.
* Excellent requirement understanding and questioning ability.
* Strong documentation and structured writing skills.
* Good problem\-solving and mathematical aptitude.
* Strong client communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to identify risks and think through edge cases.
* High ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure**.**

 **Technical Understanding**
Coding is not required, but candidates should understand:* APIs \& integrations
* Frontend/backend workflows
* Databases \& data flow
* SDLC, QA, UAT \& deployment
* Shopify/eCommerce platforms

 **Preferred Experience*** 3–4 years in IT services, software delivery, or eCommerce.
* Experience working directly with clients.
* Experience with BRD/SRS/user stories.
* Experience working with Developers and QA.
* Shopify/eCommerce project experience is preferred.

 **What We Value**
Ownership \| Structured Thinking \| Attention to Detail \| Problem Solving \| Curiosity \| Reliability
Interview Focus  

NOTE:\-**Candidates will be evaluated on logical thinking, requirement understanding, scenario\-based problem solving, technical understanding, communication, and ownership mindset.**
Interested candidates canshare their updated resume **at hr@seventhtriangle.com**.

 **Job Description**  

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced and detail\-oriented **Assistant Cost Manager** to support the delivery of cost management services across complex construction and infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate will have over 12 years of experience in quantity surveying, cost planning, budgeting, procurement, contract administration, and financial reporting. The role will involve working closely with project stakeholders to ensure effective cost control throughout the project lifecycle while maintaining adherence to budget and commercial objectives.


Key Responsibilities


Cost Management \& Planning

* Prepare and manage project cost estimates, budgets, and cost plans at various project stages.
* Monitor project expenditures and ensure alignment with approved budgets.
* Conduct cost analysis, benchmarking, and value engineering exercises.
* Support the development of project cash flow forecasts and funding requirements.
* Identify cost risks and recommend mitigation measures.


Quantity Surveying \& Procurement

* Prepare Bills of Quantities (BOQs) and tender documentation.
* Evaluate contractor and supplier bids, providing commercial recommendations.
* Support procurement strategies and contract negotiations.
* Review variations, claims, and change orders for commercial validity.


Contract Administration

* Assist in administering contracts in accordance with project requirements.
* Monitor contract compliance and commercial performance.
* Evaluate contractor payment applications and certify interim payments.
* Support dispute resolution and claims management processes.


Cost Control \& Reporting

* Track project costs, commitments, and forecasts.
* Prepare monthly commercial reports and cost performance updates.
* Monitor project financial KPIs and report variances.
* Ensure accurate documentation of all commercial and cost\-related activities.


Stakeholder Management

* Collaborate with clients, consultants, contractors, and project teams.
* Provide cost advice and commercial insights to project leadership.
* Support client presentations and commercial review meetings.
* Mentor junior quantity surveyors and cost management professionals.

  

**Qualifications**  

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Professional certification such as **MRICS, RICS, AIQS, CIOB, PMP**, or equivalent is preferred.
* Minimum **12 years of relevant experience** in cost management, quantity surveying, or commercial management.
* Experience working on large\-scale construction, infrastructure, industrial, or real estate projects.


Required Skills \& Competencies

* Strong understanding of cost estimating, budgeting, forecasting, and cost control.
* Expertise in quantity surveying and contract administration.
* Knowledge of standard forms of contracts (FIDIC, NEC, JCT, etc.).
* Strong commercial acumen and financial analysis skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and cost management software.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.

  

**Additional Information**  

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.


We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work\-life balance.


Turner \& Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.


Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/

**Job Description: Key Responsibilities**
